# Waniey.J Boutique Tailor

> Boutique tailor in Seksyen 7, Shah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia, founded in 2018 by Waniey. Makes made-to-measure clothing for men and women (baju kurung, baju Melayu, kebaya, baju nikah, suits), does clothing alterations, batik, and corporate uniforms including mass production. Has both male and female tailors, so customers are measured by staff of the same gender. Rated 5.0 on Google.

## Contact and location

- Address: 21-1-A, Jalan Kristal AS 7/AS, Seksyen 7, 40000 Shah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia
- Phone / WhatsApp: +60 10-233 3217
- Hours: Monday–Thursday 10:00–18:30, Friday closed, Saturday 10:00–18:30, Sunday 10:00–17:00
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:ChIJifqiK91TzDERmtGA1kLd5BY
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Waniey.JBoutiqueTailor/
- Website: https://wanieyj.wanuqbah.workers.dev/

## Services

- Tailor-made: baju kurung, baju Melayu, kebaya, baju nikah and suits made to the customer's measurements.
- Alterations: taking in, letting out, shortening and re-fitting existing clothes, including online purchases that don't fit. Most are ready within about a week.
- Batik: batik shirts and dresses for events, families and office dress days, individually or in matching family sets.
- Corporate uniforms: mass-production uniforms for companies, schools and teams, with on-site sizing sessions.

## How it works

1. Consult and measure: walk in or book a slot; style and fabric are discussed, then measurements are taken.
2. Cut and first fitting: the piece is cut to the customer's measurements, tried on, pinned and adjusted.
3. Final fitting and collection: one last try-on to check the fit.

## Common questions

- Appointment needed? No, walk-ins are welcome for alterations. Booking is recommended for custom designs and bulk uniform orders.
- Urgent orders? Often possible; contact the studio with the date needed.
- Price? Depends on fabric and work. Send a photo on WhatsApp for a quote before work starts.
- Languages: Bahasa Melayu and English.
